svg.title: The chain that leaves the room
svg.desc: Two walls have closed in on a slider with slanted sides, squeezing it along the floor. A chain runs from it through the open end of the room to a post on a plate of its own; it is drawn tight, lit teal, and the slider, glowing magenta, stands at a dashed mark. The loose stop that once stood at that mark has been pushed far down the room.
